summary: Adopt Git ancestry for ticket activity resolution

delivery.outcome: FixOS resolves merged ticket activity from Git ancestry while retaining active status for unmerged ticket branches, allowing goal -a to pass on the integrated main tree.
nonGoals: No change to ticket README lifecycle status or external terminal receipts.
No change to application code, tests, runtime dependencies or ticket allocation rules.
No secret access, direct merge or external mutation outside protected delivery.

architecture.decision: Use the target-owned ticket-activity override to select the managed resolver's git-ancestry fallback when external terminal receipts are absent.
architecture.rollback: Remove the target-owned override and return to status projection from the external terminal receipt registry.

validation.evidence: The override parses against the pinned target schema and selects git-ancestry.

Managed governance passes; the local Python 3.13 baseline reports 611 passed, 5 skipped and 16 deselected, with four pre-existing Click 8.3 compatibility failures outside this ticket. Fresh-main Goal validation remains a publication acceptance check.
